spans.s: प्रबद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, fastened; 2. suppressed, checked, stopped.
प्रबद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, fastened; 2. suppressed, checked, stopped.
प्रबद्धृ m. An author.

प्रबंध m. 1. A bond, a tie; 2. a continued series, क्रियाप्रबंधादयमध्वराणाम् R.vi.23; 3. uninterruptedness, continuance, R.iii.58; 4. a speech, a narration, अनुज्झितार्थसंबंधः प्रबंधो दुरुदाहरः Sis.ii.73; 5. a literary composition, particularly a poetical one, प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबंधविन्यासवैदग्ध्यनिधिर्निबंधम् Vas.D.
प्रबंध-कल्पना f. a work of imagination founded on fact, (प्रबंधकल्पनां स्तोकसत्यां प्राज्ञाः कथां विदुः).
प्रबंधन n. Bond, tie.
प्रबभ्र m. An epithet of Indra.
प्रब(व)र्ह a. (f. र्हा) Most excellent.
प्रब(व)र्ह a. (f. र्हा) Most excellent.
प्रबल a. (f. ला) 1. Strong, mighty, R.iii.60; 2. important; 3. dangerous; 4. violent, संहतां हतजीवितं मम प्रबलामात्मकृतेन वेदनाम् R.viii.50.
प्रबल a. (f. ला) 1. Strong, mighty, R.iii.60; 2. important; 3. dangerous; 4. violent, संहतां हतजीवितं मम प्रबलामात्मकृतेन वेदनाम् R.viii.50.
प्रबा(वा)ल (I) m.n. 1. A sprout, a new leaf, R.vi.12, xiii.49, K.S.i.44; 2. coral; 3. the neck of the Indian lute.
प्रबा(वा)ल (II) m. 1. A pupil; 2. an animal.
प्रब(व)ह्लिका f. The same as प्रहेलिका q.v.
प्रबाधन n. 1. Oppressing, tormenting; 2. refusing, denying.
प्रबा(वा)ल-अश्मंतक m. the red Aśmantaka tree.
प्रबा(वा)ल-पद्म n. a red lotus.
प्रबा(वा)ल-फल n. red sandal wood.
प्रबाहु m. The forearm.
प्रबाहुकम् ind. 1. On high; 2. at the same time.
प्रबुद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Awakened, roused; 2. wise, learned, clever; 3. blown, expanded; 4. beginning to take effect.
प्रबुद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Awakened, roused; 2. wise, learned, clever; 3. blown, expanded; 4. beginning to take effect.

प्रबोध m. 1. Awaking, returning to consciousness, मोहादभूत् कष्टतरः प्रबोधः R.xiv.56, xii.50; 2. blowing (as of a flower); 3. watchfulness, vigilance; 4. knowledge, wisdom, intelligence, real knowledge, Sant.S.iv.16; 5. consolation; 6. reviving the fragrance of a perfume.
प्रबोधन n. 1. Waking; 2. coming to consciousness; 3. knowledge, wisdom; 4. reviving the scent of a perfume.
प्रबोध(धि)नी f. The eleventh day of the bright fortnight of Kārtīka, the day on which Viṣṇu awakes from his sleep.
प्रबोध(धि)नी f. The eleventh day of the bright fortnight of Kārtīka, the day on which Viṣṇu awakes from his sleep.
प्रबोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Awakened, roused; 2. instructed, informed.
प्रबोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Awakened, roused; 2. instructed, informed.
प्राबल्य n. 1. Powerfulness, power, force; 2. predominance, ascendancy.
प्राबा(वा)लिक m. A dealer in coral.
प्राबोधिक m. The same as प्रबोधक q.v.
प्राबोधक m. 1. Dawn, daybreak; 2. a minstrel whose duty it is to sing songs in the morning.
